content.short: Zapper is a social Web3 explorer that lets users follow blockchain activity across NFTs, DeFi and DAOs.
content.description: Zapper is a social Web3 explorer that lets users follow the blockchain journeys of others across NFTs, DeFi, and DAOs. By highlighting public activity and on-chain history, it aims to make the complex world of cryptocurrency readable and accessible to everyone. Zapper believes that a self-custodial and decentralized future provides greater economic freedom, and that clarifying how the blockchain works is a critical step toward achieving that future for individuals and communities alike.
